hero.title: Where did your
hero.body: Genobills tells you down to the last cent, and helps the next one go further.

chapters.title: Type the math, not the answer.
chapters.body: Genobills' keypad is a calculator: 150 × 3, equals, done. You log an expense in three seconds without leaving the app.

chapters.title: Every peso in its place.
chapters.body: Categories and subcategories, grouped by day. And moving money into savings is a transfer, not an expense, so your numbers don't inflate.

chapters.title: Your month at a glance.
chapters.body: A calendar that shows which days the money went, month-over-month trends and where each peso goes by category. Not a single spreadsheet.

chapters.title: It warns you before, not after.
chapters.body: Monthly, biweekly or weekly. When a category gets close to its limit you see it in time, not on your statement.

chapters.title: Save with a date, not with hope.
chapters.body: Give it an amount and a deadline. Genobills suggests how much to set aside and tells you whether you're ahead or behind.

chapters.title: Clear accounts with your people.
chapters.body: Link your partner, roommates or friends with a code. Log what you send each other, in pesos or dollars, and see where you stand.

outro.title: Free.
outro.titleMuted: On your computer and your phone.
